## Not posted yet

This page is not posted yet.

In this two-week lab, you will correct a climate model's rainfall at a station in two ways that trust different parts of the model.
In the first week, you will quantile-map the model's daily rainfall onto the observed distribution, which trusts the model's local rainfall once its distribution is corrected.
In the second, you will find k-means weather types in reanalysis circulation, assign the model's days to them, and draw observed rainfall by type along the model's own sequence of types, which trusts its large-scale circulation and nothing about its rainfall.
You will then compare the projected change in the 25-year daily rainfall from each route.
